requiredFindings.title: The leaf open and recheck omit open_regular's status read, and the leaf name is copied before the next charge
requiredFindings.failureScenario: A ledger whose remaining edges equal the published leaf-open cost of 2 and whose remaining bytes equal one status buffer admits the open. open_regular already calls metadata before returning, and the caller calls metadata again, so one status read and its buffer are outside the reservation. file_recheck_cost has the same hole. After path_cost returns, the leaf is copied into an OsString and a String before open_accounted is charged.
